sources.evidence: Page '1992 ICPC Results' on the SPCPA site: champions with team members, then a table of 13 ranked rows with columns Position, University, Team Number, Solved, Time and no per-problem detail; it is one archive page, not a contest website.
ETH ProblemSetArchive index 'South Pacific Regionals 1992' offering only sp_92.tar and sp_92.tar.Z downloads (the copy is just the index page, not the tar).
16-page PDF headed 'South Pacific Contest, 1992' with full statements starting 'Problem A: Calculator Language', 'Problem B: Network Wars'.
ICPC Live Archive page 'Regionals 1992 :: South Pacific' listing 7 problems 5232-5238 (City Navigation appears twice in the table).
Baekjoon category '1992 ACM South Pacific Programming Contest' listing 7 problems 6400-6406 with letters A,B,D,E,F,G,H (F listed twice).
Kattis 'Problems from 1992 South Pacific Regionals' page shows 'No data found': the problem list is empty.

contest_facts.value: 13 (NZ and AUS teams, Otago NZ 4 first with 3 solved, 623)

notes: Source 1 team numbers (NZ 1-9, AUS 3-11) exceed the 13 rows shown, so the list probably omits zero-solve teams; whether the page is the complete result is a human question. No date or location appears in any source. Problem C is missing in all lists (7 problems lettered A-H without C). Source 6 may fill later on Kattis; currently empty.
